support_paths.scope: Single free world-child target; direct equality/tendon/actuator/passive paths and applied arrays. Free-joint damping is measured at the solve state and implicit velocity endpoint. No claim to detect malicious plugins or opaque external callbacks.

metadata.passive_meter: Maximum solve-state and implicit-endpoint free-joint damping wrench magnitude; rotational generalized force transformed to world COM. Other passive paths stay unknown.
metadata.sample_convention: pre-integration solve state with separately named post states
metadata.force_convention: contact-frame force/torque acts on geom2; world wrench about target COM

reference.independence: Separate raw wrench, vertex geometry and interval implementations; shared MuJoCo physics and task specification
